command: pre-registration: PLAN_PARTS targeted F3 (pi0.5 KV_14 target-identity subspace; POST-HOC follow-up of pp_f3)

metrics.arms: T = target subspace, source B (shares the target); R = random 16-dim subspace, source B (control); TA = target subspace, source A (open loop only)
metrics.closed_loop: N1-N6, familiar (primary) and new, N2 states 4-13, N2 seeds, 10 episodes per task and layout; intact = pp_f3's intact re-run
metrics.estimator: top-16 right singular vectors of within-object target contrasts (bowl K1-K2, K1-K3, K2-K3; bottle K4-K5) of layer-14 keys (de-rotated) and values at aligned valid positions, on the F1 frames
metrics.status: PRE-REGISTERED PLAN_PARTS targeted F3 (docs/PARTS_RESULTS.md section 7); POST-HOC follow-up of pp_f3
metrics.verdict: TIES iff dp_T > 0 with CI excluding 0, dg_T >= -0.10 (point), and dp_T - dp_R > 0 with CI excluding 0 (familiar layout; 2,000-draw paired bootstrap over tasks and states)
metrics.written_before: the subspace fit, the open-loop read and any closed-loop rollout
